name: Whodunit interrogation
summary: Question a handful of suspects with a limited number of questions, then accuse the culprit.
core_loop: read the crime → pick a suspect and a question → read answer → note contradictions → accuse
lose: wrong accusation or questions run out
social_hooks: same case for a Group each day
example_prompts: harry potter murder mystery
whodunit at a school dance
cluedo but the suspects are my teachers
murder at the pizza shop

name: Hidden-clue scene
summary: Tap suspicious items in a cluttered scene to collect clues, then deduce what happened.
core_loop: scan the scene → tap clues → clue list fills → deduce → pick the answer
rules: the deduction question needs 3 of the clues
example_prompts: find who stole the cake in a messy kitchen
hidden object detective at a museum
search my dorm room to find where the cat went

name: Objection! contradictions
summary: Read a witness's testimony line by line and press the line that contradicts a piece of evidence.
core_loop: read testimony line → press a line or present evidence → witness reacts → catch the contradiction
example_prompts: phoenix wright but the witness is my little brother
objection game where a parrot lies
catch the lie in a hogwarts trial

name: Elimination grid case
summary: Use statements to cross out suspects, weapons and rooms in a grid until one combination remains.
core_loop: read clues → mark grid cells → read next clue → combine → accuse
rules: each clue rules out or confirms something
the grid always has a unique solution
social_hooks: race a friend through the same grid
content_needs: clue sets that yield a unique solution
example_prompts: cluedo logic grid in a hogwarts castle
who ate the last cookie grid puzzle
crime solving grid for my squad

name: Crime-scene timeline
summary: Drag evidence into the order it must have happened, using timestamps and cause-and-effect hints.
core_loop: inspect evidence → drag cards into order → submit → reveal true order
rules: each card has a cause or time hint
social_hooks: share the red herring that tricked you
example_prompts: order the events before the cake disappeared
timeline of the school break-in
reconstruct what happened at the party

name: Fate logbook
summary: Study frozen death scenes and fill a logbook identifying each person and how they met their end.
core_loop: view a scene → inspect details → fill in identity and fate → three correct fills confirm → continue
rules: answers are confirmed in batches of three
social_hooks: share a scene that fooled you
example_prompts: obra dinn but on a school bus
identify who each passenger was
logbook mystery on a haunted train

name: Cold-case reopen
summary: A cold case has a dozen old files; pick which to reread, spot what changed, and name what the original police missed.
core_loop: open file → read → flag oversights → combine two files → new lead → name the missed fact
rules: only 6 files can be opened per run
combining two files can reveal a lead
final answer is one missed fact
example_prompts: cold case at a summer camp
reopen the haunted school mystery
cold case about a missing garden gnome

name: Spot the liar
summary: Several suspects each make a statement; exactly one lies, and working out which statements conflict reveals the culprit.
core_loop: read statements → mark who must be lying → find culprit consistent with the truths → accuse
rules: the culprit is the only consistent answer
social_hooks: post a case for your Group
content_needs: statement sets with unique consistent solutions
example_prompts: one of my friends is lying about who ate the donut
liar puzzle with five dragons
who is lying in the group chat

name: Cipher clue decode
summary: Decode a ciphered clue found in the story to unlock the next location.
core_loop: find cipher → apply key from other clue → read plaintext → move on → final reveal
rules: the key comes from earlier clues
the cipher is simple (shift, symbol swap)
social_hooks: send a coded message to a friend
example_prompts: national treasure but the treasure is in my school
decode the pirate map clue
spy cipher to find the hidden cookie jar

name: Suspect string board
aliases: The Case of the Golden Idol
summary: Connect photos and notes on a pinboard with strings to show how people, places and objects link.
core_loop: study cards → draw strings between related cards → game checks links → complete the web → name the culprit
rules: links must be justified by shared facts
win: name the culprit from the web
social_hooks: share a screenshot of your web
example_prompts: pinboard case of the missing school mascot
conspiracy board for my roommates
connect the strings in a vampire murder

name: Leads with a clock
summary: Each lead costs a unit of time; chase the right ones before the clock runs out and the culprit slips away.
core_loop: read case → choose lead → pay time → learn clue → decide to chase or accuse
example_prompts: catch a thief before the 6 o'clock bell
sherlock holmes style mystery with 10 turns
crime solver against the clock in a candy factory

name: Clue ladder guess
summary: A secret identity reveals clues from vague to specific; guessing earlier scores more.
core_loop: see clue 1 → optionally guess → see next clue → guess → reveal
lose: all clues shown with no guess
example_prompts: guess the mystery wizard from clues
who am i but all the answers are my teachers
mystery guest game with clues

name: Eyewitness memory
summary: See a crime scene for a few seconds, then answer questions about details as a witness; correct details identify the culprit.
core_loop: glimpse scene → scene hidden → answer questions → correct answers narrow the culprit → pick
rules: the lineup depends on answered correctly
win: pick the right person in the lineup
lose: pick wrong or too many errors
example_prompts: be an eyewitness to a cafeteria theft
observe a scene for 5 seconds then pick who did it
memory crime scene game

name: What changed?
summary: Study a room, then it changes slightly; find what moved or vanished, since that is the clue to the case.
core_loop: study room → room blinks → find what changed → each change is a clue → combine
rules: each found change adds a clue
a limited number of wrong taps
social_hooks: compare how quickly friends spot changes
example_prompts: spot what changed in the haunted bedroom
find who moved the cookie jar
what changed in the principal's office

name: Dinner party poisoning
summary: A dinner is poisoned; track who sat where, who served what, and who could reach the glass to narrow down the poisoner.
core_loop: read seating → read serving order → mark who had access → eliminate → accuse
rules: access depends on seat and timing
exactly one person fits all rules
social_hooks: create a dinner for a friend
example_prompts: knives out but at my family thanksgiving
who poisoned the tea at hogwarts feast
orient express dinner puzzle with six passengers

name: Forensic matching
summary: Match a trace (fingerprint, footprint, fabric) from the scene to a suspect from a lineup of near-identical options.
core_loop: inspect trace → compare to suspects → rotate or zoom → pick best match → case advances
example_prompts: fingerprint match to find who touched the cookie jar
footprint matching to catch the garden thief
csi lab speed round

name: Noir narration choices
summary: A hardboiled detective monologue; you pick the tone of each line and which lead to follow, and tone changes how informants talk.
core_loop: hear narration → pick lead or tone → informant reacts → clue → solve
rules: informants respond to tone (tough, charming, honest)
leads lock when you burn bridges
example_prompts: noir detective about a stolen ice cream truck
hardboiled narration for finding my lost sock
disco elysium style detective but i'm a pigeon

name: Interrogation pressure
summary: For each statement choose to believe, doubt or accuse; the right call advances the case while the wrong call spooks the suspect.
core_loop: statement → choose believe, doubt, accuse → suspect reacts → pressure meter → confession or walkout
rules: the right call per statement is determined by evidence
a confession needs the right 3 calls
example_prompts: interrogate my little brother about the missing cookies
good cop bad cop game
question the dragon about the missing gold

name: Missing-pet trail
summary: A cozy case: follow footprints and neighbors' hints through a small map to find a missing pet.
core_loop: visit location → talk to neighbor → get hint → update map → find the pet
rules: hints narrow the pet's hiding place
no failure state, just clue counting
the pet is found at the last logical spot
social_hooks: share where your pet was found
make a case for a friend's pet
example_prompts: find my missing hamster in the neighborhood
cozy mystery of the lost cat
where is my dragon, a cozy detective game

name: Museum theft access log
summary: A museum item vanishes; read guard schedules, badge logs and camera gaps to find the one person who could have taken it.
core_loop: read schedules → check badge logs → find gaps → eliminate → accuse
rules: exactly one person fits the timing
example_prompts: who stole the dinosaur skull from the museum
museum thief logic puzzle
badge log mystery at a candy factory

name: Group daily case
summary: A new short case drops each day for the whole Group; everyone solves independently and compares.
core_loop: open daily case → gather clues → accuse → reveal the answer → compare ranks
example_prompts: a daily murder mystery for our group chat
daily detective puzzle like wordle
everyone solves the same case every morning

name: Mole hunt
summary: Watch a short log of coworkers' behavior and guess the one who is secretly the mole from patterns.
core_loop: read log of day → note odd behaviors → compare days → pick the mole → reveal
rules: the mole breaks one pattern each day
social_hooks: race to spot the mole earliest
content_needs: behavior logs with a mole pattern
example_prompts: find the mole in my office by watching their lunch habits
spy game: who is the double agent
which teacher is secretly a vampire

name: Tells and bluffs
summary: Watch a short animated suspect statement; judge truth or lie from tells like eye shifts, pauses and wording.
core_loop: watch statement → note tells → mark truth or lie → score → streak
rules: each suspect has one tell pattern
example_prompts: lie to me style game for my group chat
read the liar at a school trial
truth or lie detective

name: Observe and infer
summary: Look at a stranger's belongings and details and pick the true conclusions about their day.
core_loop: study a picture → pick the inference options → feedback shows right/wrong → next stranger
rules: each detail supports exactly one inference
lose a life for each wrong pick
social_hooks: send a stranger to a friend
example_prompts: sherlock holmes deduce my day from my backpack
what did this stranger do this morning
observation game: infer a wizard's day

name: Map clue trail
summary: Clues each point to a place; follow the trail across a map and catch the thief at the last stop.
core_loop: read clue → pick the location on a map → arrive → get next clue → arrest at final stop
rules: each clue names a landmark indirectly
social_hooks: share a clue that stumped you
example_prompts: carmen sandiego but through my school
follow clues across a fantasy map
chase a thief through a mall

name: Ghost investigation
summary: Search rooms for evidence types and use them to identify which ghost type haunts the house.
core_loop: search room → find evidence → mark types → rule out ghosts → name the ghost
example_prompts: ghost hunting in my grandma's attic
phasmophobia but cozy
identify the haunted house ghost from evidence

name: Torn-note reconstruction
summary: Reassemble a torn note or map by placing fragments; the restored text names the answer.
core_loop: drag fragment → snap to match → text forms → read message → accuse
rules: fragments snap by matching edges or text flow
message reveals a name or place
win: read the message and act on it
social_hooks: send a torn note to a friend
example_prompts: reassemble the torn ransom note
piece together the pirate map
fix the shredded love letter to find the culprit

name: Alibi timeline grid
summary: Each suspect claims where they were at each hour; overlapping alibis and locations expose who couldn't have been where they claim.
core_loop: read alibi table → mark conflicts → eliminate → accuse
rules: one suspect has an impossible alibi
win: accuse the one with the impossible alibi
content_needs: alibi table with a travel-time impossibility
example_prompts: whose alibi is impossible at the school dance
time table mystery with six wizards
alibi logic for who stole the wallet

name: Unmask the disguise
summary: A masked culprit has left behavioral traces across scenes; match the traces to the cast and unmask them.
core_loop: collect traces across scenes → compare to cast profile → unmask → reveal
rules: traces include handedness, shoe size, speech habit
cast profiles list the same traits
social_hooks: share the trace that gave it away
content_needs: traces and profiles with one match
example_prompts: scooby doo style unmask game
find the masked guy at the school gala
unmask the ghost in the amusement park

name: Hotel floor case
summary: Visit rooms along a hallway, each yielding one clue about a guest; assemble a profile of who is hiding what.
core_loop: open door → meet guest → learn secret → assemble relationships → decide who did it
rules: the answer is the guest named by three others
social_hooks: compare which doors you opened first
share the guest who surprised you
example_prompts: investigate a hotel full of wizards
hallway detective at a school camp
a hotel where every room has a secret

name: Receipt and phone-log case
summary: Compare receipts, call logs and photos across people to find the single inconsistency that cracks the case.
core_loop: open item → check against statement → mark mismatch → build theory → submit
content_needs: documents with consistent and inconsistent facts
example_prompts: find the fake alibi from receipts and texts
her story style call logs for my teacher mystery
phone logs cracked the case

name: Secret society codewords
summary: Meet members and learn that each demands a different phrase; deduce which password goes with whom to infiltrate.
core_loop: meet member → hear hint → try phrase → feedback → gain trust → reach inner circle
rules: each member hints at their phrase
social_hooks: create a secret society for a friend
example_prompts: infiltrate the wizards' club by guessing passwords
spy codewords at a school
secret society initiation with riddles

name: Locked-room puzzle
summary: The culprit is obvious but the crime seems impossible; pick the facts that explain how it was done.
core_loop: read the impossible scene → test hypotheses → eliminate the impossible → pick the mechanism
rules: each hypothesis can be tested once
example_prompts: locked room mystery at a wizard library
how did the cookie vanish from a sealed jar
impossible crime in a snowed-in cabin

name: Motive, means, opportunity
summary: For each suspect rate motive, means and opportunity from evidence, and the highest-scoring suspect is the culprit.
core_loop: read evidence → score each suspect on three axes → sum → accuse top
rules: each piece of evidence adds or removes points
example_prompts: profile suspects for the school bake sale theft
motive means opportunity for a wizard crime
rank who did it in the group chat

name: Style attribution
summary: Compare an anonymous note's phrasing and quirks with samples from suspects to attribute the note.
core_loop: read note → read samples → match quirks (spelling, slang) → pick author
rules: quirks like spelling, emoji use and catchphrases
social_hooks: write a note with your own quirks for friends to attribute
example_prompts: who wrote the threatening note in the group chat
forensic linguistics detective game
guess which friend sent the anonymous text

name: Be the culprit
summary: You are the culprit; clean up traces and plant false clues before the detective's inspection counts what's left.
core_loop: survey crime scene → remove or plant items → detective inspects → leftover clues counted
social_hooks: be the culprit for a friend
example_prompts: be the culprit at the school pizza party and hide it
cover up the broken vase before mom checks
reverse mystery where i'm the thief
